column3: Port of BootUI 2.4.0 #1597 StaticSecurityAnalysisRule: detects local static security analyzer declarations without running them; bounds 1 MiB/file, <= 64 workflows, symlink/special-file refusal, INDETERMINATE on malformed/oversized. Python adaptation: project root from app package pyproject locator (never cwd); recommendation and url adapted to Python analyzers (Bandit, Semgrep, CodeQL, a sonar-project.properties file, Ruff with S selected).
